compactRecord.rs: Sommeralm is a pleasant pastoral highland plateau (~1400m) in the Grazer Bergland near Graz; green rolling alm meadows, a chapel, huts, and a small ski resort give it modest summit interest, but the road is unremarkable and it has no international fame.
compactRecord.td: Sommeralm is a broad alpine meadow plateau 30 km north of Graz, part of one of the largest contiguous alm regions in the Alps. compactRecord.rs: In Bad Blumau, ~80 km SE of Graz via A2. Hotel and day-visitor access. Open year-round. Book well in advance for overnight stays.
compactRecord.td: A fantastical thermal village designed by Friedensreich Hundertwasser: undulating colourful facades, grass-roofed bungalows and three thermal pools in a single surreal complex. Among Central Europe's most architecturally distinctive spa resorts.
